name: Mutable Instruments modules
author: Emilie Gillet (Mutable Instruments); wrapper by dawlings

provides.title: PLAITS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' macro oscillator: 24 engines from virtual analogue to modal, granular, drums and speech.

provides.title: RINGS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' resonator: strike it with a trigger and hear modal bodies, strings and bells.

provides.title: REVERB
provides.blurb: A lush plate-like reverb from Mutable Instruments' Clouds.

provides.title: CLOUDS
provides.blurb: Mutable Instruments' granular processor: listens to what comes in and plays it back as a cloud of grains.
